scope: Consistent 2–6 Bot group creation, searchable recipients, suggested names, palette and keyboard entry, preservation of existing groups
skipped: Existing Linux-only file-descriptor race and dedicated UID checks on macOS.

behaviorEvidence.creation: Shared constants enforce 2–6 distinct Bots in manual groups, planner tool schema/prompt, new chat proposals and commit. Explicit one-person groups, duplicate IDs, disguised multi-Bot DMs and invalid isGroup types are rejected. True one-Bot DMs remain supported.
behaviorEvidence.legacy: Existing groups can keep or reduce to one member. Groups above six can keep/reorder/remove original members, but cannot introduce outsiders until a smaller group has been saved. Existing single-person plan receipts remain readable and editable; new commit requires at least two. Runtime continues to serve existing single/oversized groups.
behaviorEvidence.selection: Searchable recipients expose selected chips and leader order. Default names follow selections until manually edited; explicit reset restores the suggestion. Creation submits only selected IDs and does not start work. Busy/unknown saves cannot replay via stale handlers.
behaviorEvidence.navigation: Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+N opens group mode; Cmd/Ctrl+K provides searchable creation commands and chat history. Open dialogs/IME/repeat/stale identity protect drafts. Members see only group creation commands. Current-chat search remains history-only; commands close search before opening the next dialog.
behaviorEvidence.identity: Conversation create and delete validate supplied expected-account headers through existing mutation authorization. Real temporary team HTTP checks reject old-account requests without modifying data. Existing headerless API compatibility and shared-main-DM guards are preserved.
behaviorEvidence.model: One actual request to the user-selected GLM endpoint produced a validated six-member proposal reusing all six synthetic Bots, with a leader and assignments. No Bot or conversation was created, no work tool executed, and formal settings remained unchanged.

desktopPackage.note: Native files unchanged; existing client loads separately running web service. No new native-window acceptance.

limitations: Product browser control remains unavailable; React event and controlled engine tests do not prove product visual/focus/touch acceptance.
Group membership in older groups is preserved; new 2–6 rules do not retroactively delete historical members.
Remaining full-reference feature and multi-device gaps remain recorded in reference-audit.md; original goal remains active.
